changes: Status labels are tinted pills with an icon and words. Buttons are flat: solid maroon for the main action, outlined maroon for the rest.
One family of corners (8, 12 and 16 px). Gradients, glows and bevels are gone, and nothing loops while a page loads.
A button shows a spinner while it saves, and messages arrive with a short motion.
Phones use one 760 px breakpoint for layout and lists, 48 px fields and 44 px touch targets.
